cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

mechanism: A leads a workshop move but accepts B hybrid proposal and preferred wording only to press for an eventual choice of whose authority B supports.
confusable: Unlike coalition-building, A will not let a shared policy substitute for allegiance; borrowed authority concedes substance to keep B answering the loyalty question.
comparison: Meeting ownership of a compromise differs from election-day ribbon choices between friends.
seedUse: Use D58-a location/budget/compromise/claim correction and S02-a incorporating B preferences as the plan.
